rows.name: WATER
rows.plain: QTS says it uses zero water for cooling. No public record confirms that here. If it cooled like the industry average: 1,200 families' worth.
rows.caveat: To settle it: this site's metered water use, from Fort Worth Water.

rows.name: TAX DOLLARS
rows.plain: The state list has 167 certified data centers. This site is not one of them. City and county tax breaks: not found.
rows.caveat: To settle it: the abatement agreement and tax paid, from the Tarrant Appraisal District.

rows.name: JOBS
rows.plain: QTS does not publish jobs for this site. At 127 employers in this county.
rows.also: Texas: 47,620 jobs. About $21,300 of uncollected sales tax per job.
rows.caveat: Includes cloud office jobs. Leaves out construction.

claims.text: Achieved 100% utilization of carbon-free operational electricity by our facilities
claims.why: Bought over a year, maybe. Hour by hour, the Texas grid ran mostly on coal and gas in 59 of every 100 hours.
